checks.detail: Both bound receipts bind candidate b49070167c09 with fresh build, embedded assets, identifier-derived isolated store, source/binary unchanged, and every blocking check pass (collector_exit_code 0). White-box: prd-boundary, typescript, vite-build, rust-format, and rust-check exit 0 and rust-unit is 50/50, covering the auth chain (register/verify/signin/restart persist), generic wrong-password with rate limiting, private operations rejecting without a session, single-use/expired/reused recovery tokens, focusboard scheme registration, the deeplink ledger, and opt-in-gated diagnostics. Black-box: two independent disposable-profile drives (drive accounts signing in 06:56 and 06:58) pass anonymous validation smoke and signed-in navigation of all six PRD-8 surfaces with matched hydrated headings. I inspected all 13 bound captures against PRD 9: calm editorial canvas, restrained amber accent, light structural columns, icons paired with labels, wrapped/truncated long titles, and no dark-blue panels, pill walls, or pseudo-technical copy. The loop-20 InboxView change (filtered-empty state with Clear filters, active-filter result count, open/completed split) renders correctly in both runs with no regression on any other surface. Remaining gaps (section-3 journey receipt, recovery capture, external focusboard:// activation, PRD 9.2 states) are host-lane measurement debt reported as minor findings, not product failures.

White-box layer verified: the receipt's rust-unit 50/50 includes golden_path_section3_self_drive, register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists, malformed_expired_and_reused_link_tokens_stay_recoverable, and the authz/reminder suites, covering auth, task, focus, reminder, recovery, and persistence in-process. Black-box layer: the host collector drove anonymous smoke with a field-associated validation message (replay-validation.png), then two independent signed-in drives whose results are visible in the captures: the completed task with due date 2026/09/21 appears in Today, Inbox, and the Projects DONE column and on its Calendar date, Focus history records a completed session, and Settings shows the driven profile with reminders enabled and an active session, with matched hydrated headings on all six surfaces in both runs. Still missing is the host-owned per-step section-3 receipt: golden_path evidence_scope remains anonymous_smoke_plus_triggered_product_self_drive with independently_verified=false, the 16/16 self-report is renderer-self-drive-ipc (untrusted), the reminder email content and the forgot-to-reset-to-sign-in journey have no bound capture, and the developer risk-handoff webdriver pass was not re-run (not_validated). These are carried as minor insufficient-evidence findings routed to host follow-up, not converted into product failures.
